sources: sizes: the hotel's own capacity chart (https://courtlandgrandhotel.com/floor-plan-capacity-charts/, read 2026-10-03). The chart gives each room's area and not its sides: the sides are the whole feet whose product is the chart's area and whose shape is the plan's

placement, order and orientation: the hotel's own floor plan, reference/plans/courtland-grand-site-2024-level-1.webp, the picture of level 1 on the same page (1514 x 1138 px), measured from the two banks of elevators it draws (DECISIONS #28: read for position only, nothing copied)
which rooms the con uses, what it calls them and which way is north: Dragon Con's 2026 map, reference/dragoncon/ (read only)
notes: the lowest of the hotel's three meeting floors, below the lobby: the Georgia Ballroom on the Courtland Street side, the Capitol Ballroom in the middle and the Atlanta rooms east of it, with the prefunction halls along their north ends

the Georgia Ballroom is the con's name for what the hotel calls Georgia Hall: Georgia 2 to 12 opened into one room, six rooms down the west side and five down the east. It is drawn as one room, 84 x 162 ft, the chart's rooms added up; the corner at its north-east, 45 x 29 ft, is GA 1 and its stairs, which are not part of the hall. The hotel's venues page prints the hall as 160 x 76.9: its area over 160

the hotel divides the Capitol Ballroom into three: North, 57 ft, then Center and South, 40 ft each, 137 x 70 together. The con's map draws two, North Capitol and South Capitol, with the wall between them where the plan draws the one between Center and South; so North Capitol is drawn as the hotel's North and Center together, 97 ft, and South Capitol as its South
Atlanta 1 to 5 are five equal rooms in a row, 1 at the north end, 130 x 32 together
the two prefunction halls are drawn by eye; the Georgia Prefunction also runs down the hall's west side, which is not drawn
Convention information is Dragon Con's map's, in the Georgia Prefunction, placed by eye; the entrance is the one the con's map marks, on the Andrew Young International Blvd side

the plan is measured from the two banks of elevators all three floors' plans draw. At that scale it draws the Georgia hall about 87 x 165 ft, the Capitol Ballroom 68 x 138 and the Atlanta rooms 31 x 126
